goal.statement: Turn one repetitive operational workflow into a paid, bounded AI-assisted service.
goal.human_outcome: A customer gets less repetitive work while retaining control over consequential decisions.

state.current: Digital Worker Factory already has capability gates, evidence requirements, shadow mode, RevenueOS and a €1,900 sprint offer.

gap.blocker: No paid customer has yet produced observed before/after value evidence.
gap.why_now: The runtime is mature enough that more platform code has lower leverage than a real paid shadow pilot.

options: Sell and run one supervised shadow pilot
Expand into another vertical before proof

decision.selected_path: Sell and run one supervised shadow pilot
decision.rationale: It produces cash, failure data, real value evidence and the strongest signal for what to automate next.

action.next_action: Run one €1,900 AI Operations Sprint with external actions disabled during the first shadow measurement.
action.executor: Digital Worker Factory with human operator

stop_conditions: customer workflow cannot plausibly repay pilot cost
required data access is unsafe or unavailable
false completion or unsafe action escapes containment

feedback.next_cycle_trigger: Pilot evidence changes the workflow, price, autonomy boundary or expansion decision.
